expected_flag: CACE +2.5% significant on triggered users; ITT diluted (~tau x CACE) and underpowered — naive ITT-only read misses a real effect. Rollout impact ~= CACE x trigger rate.

power_adequacy.note: CACE power assumes the +2.5% triggered lift; CUPED R^2=0.5 is load-bearing for the triggered analysis.

note: 20k-user committed sample of the full n=400000 run; power adequacy figures refer to the full n.
